description: The settings READ answers with both knobs and the three-state `known` (P31): `known=false` says no component owns this root — the values shown are then the slice's DECLARED defaults (`ask`, `manual`, R4) and never masquerade as a stored fact. A write names BOTH knobs at once (queueAdvance and sizingMode together, or neither): two callers each changing one knob would agree on a third state nobody said. A half-pair is a shape error decided before the store is touched.
